lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 15-20 high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in a semi-regular grid posterior to the fifth branchial slit. The arrangement follows three primary horizontal rows that exhibit slight ventral curvature as they progress towards the caudal region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal carinae. High-luminance blobs are positioned at the majority of these grid-like nodes, creating a checkerboard pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal linear features running parallel across the upper two-thirds of the flank. Each ridge is defined by a sharp vertical gradient, with high-intensity pixels on the dorsal-facing edge and a high-contrast shadow region immediately below.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately 8-10 high-luminance blobs are distributed across the visible surface of the first dorsal fin, with a higher concentration observed in the lower anterior quadrant of the fin's silhouette.
